desc: Ideation: identified set-based reformulation (pairing within a color is free; only chosen sets and per-color even counts matter) and candidate directions (top-2K by max-value + parity fix, mask DP, Lagrangian).

Prove the reduction: answer = max over assignments of 2K distinct cakes to colors {X,Y,Z} with each color used an even number of times of the sum of assigned coordinate values (argmax coloring gives ≤; arbitrary pairing within groups gives ≥ since max ≥ chosen coordinate).

Design and verify the parity-fix: base = top 2K cakes by m_i=max(X,Y,Z) assigned to argmax color; if 0 odd color-counts, done; if exactly 2 odd, compute min-loss fix over single ops and two-op XZ+YZ combos (nets (-1,+1,0),(+1,-1,0),(-1,-1,+2),(+1,+1,-2)), handling outsider/Z-group distinctness with top-2 candidates; ≥3-op combos dominated.

Verify correctness against a brute-force (itertools combinations over small N, all pairings) on random tests, especially tie-heavy cases (all equal values, zeros) and cases where outsiders tie with S0 boundary; include N=2K (no outsiders) to check NEG/INF guards. — found distinctness bug in p5/p6 mixed two-outsider terms.

Patch `p5` and `p6` mixed two-outsider terms to use `best_pair_sum_diff(outC, outB)` / `best_pair_sum_diff(outC, outA)` (guard NEG when <2 distinct outsiders), then re-run ≥20k randomized brute-force cases to confirm zero mismatches.

Double-check pattern 7/8 distinctness subcases (both-replace with same-color outsiders; two flips sharing a C-cake; flip+replace sharing a C-cake; groupC with exactly 1 cake; `minC2 != INF` guard), and clean up any leftover dead code in the current solution.
Handle edge cases: K = N/2 (no outsiders — replace ops invalid, guarded by -INF checks), N=2, all zeros.
Write final Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), sanity-check against the two samples by hand, and output code in the required delimiters.
